description: PAID ($0.01, one payment covers a batch of up to 50 URLs): structured content as JSON — title, headings, paragraphs, links, images, document-order markdown. Provide exactly one of "url" (a single page) or "urls" (a batch); "url" is shorthand for a one-item "urls".

schema.description: Optional natural-language description of the JSON to extract. Omit it to get the default page structure.

url.description: A single page to extract, e.g. https://example.com/. Shorthand for "urls": ["<url>"]. Mutually exclusive with "urls" — sending both is an error.

urls.description: Batch of pages for one payment, at most 50 items; a batch of one is allowed. Mutually exclusive with "url" — sending both is an error.

name: webcap_extract
